independence_statement: Independent model-review execution, not human annotation. I used only rubric_v1.json and assigned frozen/packet_r1.json as review inputs, grouping duplicate contexts for reading. I did not access conditions, original IDs, F1, source selections, repository history, another review, external sources, or run new model/API/GPU/browser inference. The shared filesystem permits only procedural blinding; this review does not claim human or different-model expertise.
